articles.title: Indian Mustard Market: Rajasthan Sowing Delays and Price Outlook
articles.summary: Rajasthan’s mustard sowing lags last year by about 46%, raising supply concerns. Analysis of drivers, weather risks and price outlook for the mustard market. articles.title: Viral video falsely claims India Defence Minister criticized army over border tensions
articles.summary: A viral video falsely attributes statements to India Defence Minister Rajnath Singh regarding India-China border tensions and Indian Army personnel. Fact checkers confirmed the footage is digitally manipulated and actually shows Singh responding to political remarks made by Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge in Patna. Artificial intelligence detection tools flagged both the video and audio as deepfakes.

articles.title: Democratic US Congress sweep creates new challenges for Modi government
